messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated /fn_call usage observed across hosted clusters (eu-west-1, us-west-2). Metric: fn_call_per_min spike to ~6.5M (baseline 400k). Paging @eng-oncall. https://incidents.internal/r/1768001234 :rotating_light:

alex chen: seeing it. graphs look like a steep ramp starting ~00:05 UTC. a couple of big tenants show most of the volume. link: https://console.internal/metrics?m=fn_call_per_min&range=1h

priya rao: noticed a correlated surge from agent-%build: looks like an aggressive retry loop in 3rd-party orchestration tool. request payloads are short but include structured/json output and frequent tool invocations.

mateo gonzalez: confirm. top 3 tenants are generating 78% of tool calls. latency is creeping up for gen endpoints too. we should contain blast radius — plan: 1) apply per-tenant fn_call rate caps for non-enterprise tiers, 2) disable structured output (json/fn_call wrapper) for free/trial tenants, 3) enable emergency backpressure on streaming to avoid token storms.

alex chen: +1. let's avoid blanket disable for enterprise customers. we can tag tenants by tier and route at the gateway. i can push a soft cap rule quickly.

sam ong: i'm taking pager. alex — can you post the admin command you'll run so i can follow/approve? also i'll open a ticket to notify affected customers.

alex chen: running the following in admin to add a tagged ratecap rule (rolling):

```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/config/rate-rules \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "rule_name": "fncall_tagged_soft_cap",
    "matcher": {"header": "x-tenant-tier", "equals": ["free","trial", "dev"]},
    "actions": {"max_fn_calls_per_min": "500", "throttle_mode": "soft_drop"},
    "rollout": {"scope": "global", "priority": 40}
  }'
```

alex chen: also deploying structured-output toggle for the same tiers. it'll force responses to plain text and disable function call invocation at the gateway level:

```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/config/feature-flags \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{
    "flag": "disable_structured_output",
    "target": {"tenant_tiers": ["free","trial","dev"]},
    "value": true
  }'
```

priya rao: good. i recommend we start with max_fn_calls_per_min=500 and watch for error spikes. if retries increase, reduce to 200. set alerts for 429 ratio > 5% and client-side retry loops.

mateo gonzalez: i'm patching the autoscaler policy to prioritize gen traffic over fn_call workers and enabling prefix-KV caching more aggressively. should free up slots for regular generation.

console-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: rule "fncall_tagged_soft_cap" created by alex. rollout started (0/100 nodes).

alex chen: rollout at 22% after 30s. initial drop in global fn_call rate ~18%.

sam ong: creating customer-facing ticket now — short note explaining temporary limitation on tool/structured outputs for free/trial tiers and asking them to contact support if they need immediate removal. ticket: CS-98412.

priya rao: we should also tag the big noisy tenants for manual throttling. they look like 3rd-party integrators that will need coordination. i'm drafting a short ops note to send to acct teams.

mateo gonzalez: console shows reduced pressure on fn_call workers. gen latency stabilized. still seeing a tail of retries from one tenant. i'd like to add a per-tenant circuit breaker: if a tenant's fn_call_errors > 5% for 2m, disable fn_call for that tenant and notify SE.

alex chen: agree. i'll add a temporary circuit-breaker rule scoped to tenant IDs for the top offenders. command:```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/config/circuit-breakers \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"per_tenant_fncall_cb","condition":{"error_rate_gt_pct":5,"window_sec":120},"action":{"disable_fn_call":true,"notify":true}}'
```

console-bot: CIRCUIT-BREAKER: per_tenant_fncall_cb created. monitoring for matches.

sam ong: handoff note for next shift: we applied soft global caps for free/trial/dev tiers, disabled structured output for those tiers, and added a per-tenant circuit breaker. enterprise customers unaffected. tickets opened: CS-98412 (customer notification), OPS-4093 (postmortem). current status: fn_call rate ~520k (down from 6.5M).

alex chen: logging all commands in OPS-4093. i'll follow up with a short doc on how to undo flags and stable thresholds for future incidents.

priya rao: one more ask — add a temporary metric dashboard tile for "fn_call 429 ratio" and a short runbook entry so oncall can pick comms thresholds next time.

mateo gonzalez: noted. i'll push a dashboard patch and add the runbook snippet.

sam ong: taking the rest of the incident. if anything regresses ping me in this thread with @sam ong and tag urgent. otherwise i'll start the impact assessment and coordinate with account teams. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied. status: stabilizing. follow-ups: OPS-4093, CS-98412.

sam ong: final note for handoff — recommend post-incident action items: 1) automated detection of high fn_call churn patterns, 2) default soft caps for new tenants, 3) educate partners on exponential backoff best practices. closing active mitigation in 15m unless we see regression.
